correctness.rationale: The equivariant finite deleted-product model is supported by Barnett–Farber [1]. The standalone verifier constructs all 190, 540, and 375 cells and both signed boundaries; verifies D1 D2=0; enumerates all 20 hexagons and 70 disjoint pairs; checks D2 times every torus chain is zero; establishes rank(D2)=340 using an exact F101 rank lower bound and a 35-column unit minor; proves integral saturation by the determinant -1; checks a separate determinant +1 on the 10-orbit; and computes exact Smith factors (339 unit, one 2). The program independently checks all 375 chain coordinates for the full S5×C2 representatives before extracting character traces and irreducible multiplicities. No extrapolation to other graphs is claimed.

value.rationale: This is a canonical highly symmetric nonplanar graph for which shortest geometric 2-torus classes are natural but not guaranteed to generate degree-two homology. The dichotomy of torus orbits (60 versus 10), the explicit integral generating orbit with a unimodular certificate, the primitive proper rank-ten orbit, and the complete rational automorphism character provide distinct structural information beyond Betti numbers and general algorithms. These precise geometric-generator and symmetry invariants have plausible reuse in comparisons of graph braid groups and integral topological generators.
